_comment: GCC marketing agencies (gcc-agencies), built from the 2026-08-25 qualification research: independent medium / medium-large digital, performance and SEO agencies, Dubai first then Riyadh / Abu Dhabi / Jeddah / Doha. Source order mirrors gcc-outreach: gmaps first (highest measured yield on this stack), then overture (bulk, ~half the rows already carry a domain), then map (OSM office=advertising_agency|marketing), then places. PLACES CAVEAT, verified against Google's live Table A docs 2026-08-25: Nearby Search has NO advertising_agency or marketing_agency includedType — marketing_consultant is the closest honest Table A type, so that source under-covers real agencies and over-returns solo consultants; it is the last-rung backup, and the ICP filtering happens at qualify/enrich time. Precision terms/categories come from the shared presets (gmaps_presets.json / overture_presets.json, key 'marketing') so every future agency campaign inherits them. resolve_domains ON: GCC office POIs are frequently name-only in OSM.
